james-valley-grain.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 4 James Valley Grain locations, 3 in North Dakota and 1 in South Dakota. The North Dakota bids come from towns like Berlin, Oakes and Verona, and the South Dakota bid comes from Aberdeen. The table carries corn and soybeans.

jbs-live-pork.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 8 JBS Live Pork locations buying grain in 3 states. Iowa has 4, including Hedrick, Morning Sun, Oakville and Richland, Missouri has 3 at Centralia, Fairfax and Smithton, and Illinois has 1 at Bushnell. The table carries corn and soybeans.
